skill.name: thought-mining
skill.description: Guides a staged conversation that turns scattered ideas into article insights, topic choices, validated claims, draft revisions, and a final publishing review.
skill.summary: Turn scattered ideas into structured article drafts through guided thought mining.
skill.author: yunshu0909

security_audit.summary: The static command findings are false positives caused by markdown inline-code markers and a fenced file tree. The entropy findings are false positives from readable Chinese markdown prose, not binary or encrypted content. A separate filesystem safety issue remains because the workflow creates local files from user-provided topic names.

remediation.issue: User-controlled filenames are used for local note creation.
remediation.suggestion: Sanitize topic values, remove path separators, keep files in the current workspace, and ask before creating or overwriting files.

remediation.issue: Web validation can disclose private article topics or claims.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for user approval before web searches and summarize search terms before using external tools.

semantic_findings.title: Unconstrained Local File Creation
semantic_findings.description: The workflow tells the agent to create insight and writing-record files using the user-provided topic. Without filename sanitization or confirmation, a topic containing path separators could write to an unintended local path.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file creation instructions are explicit and derive filenames from the topic placeholder. The risk depends on agent behavior, so confidence is high but not absolute.

semantic_findings.title: External Search May Expose Sensitive Topics
semantic_findings.description: The validation stage instructs the agent to search using the topic and core concepts. It does not require user confirmation before sending potentially private writing ideas to external search tools.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The network-search instruction is clear, but the data exposure depends on the user topic and available tools. This is a privacy risk rather than evidence of malicious exfiltration.

content.user_title: Develop Article Ideas Through Thought Mining
content.value_statement: Writers often lose useful ideas before they become clear article topics. This skill guides a staged conversation that captures insights, selects a topic, validates facts, and reviews drafts.
actual_capabilities: Guides users through five writing stages from idea capture to final review.
Creates insight and writing record files using provided templates.
Helps identify three to five promising ideas from collected insights.
Validates technical or product claims through web research when needed.
Reviews draft logic, wording, memorable lines, and publication readiness.
limitations: The source instructions are mainly Chinese and optimized for Chinese writing sessions.
It requires agent file access to create or read local note files.
Web validation depends on available search tools and source quality.
It does not replace expert legal, medical, financial, or technical review.

use_cases.title: Develop Article Angles
use_cases.description: Capture scattered thoughts, identify useful insights, and turn them into a focused article direction.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Thought Leadership
use_cases.description: Explore product opinions, validate claims, and shape a publishable narrative before drafting.

use_cases.title: Organize Research Notes
use_cases.description: Turn exploratory notes into a clear thesis, supporting structure, and final review checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Start Thought Mining
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner session for a new article idea.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use thought-mining to help me explore an article idea about [topic]. Ask one question at a time and record useful insights.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Core Topic
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate session after collecting several insights.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use thought-mining stage 2. Review my collected insights, identify the strongest three to five ideas, and help me choose one article direction.

prompt_templates.title: Validate an Argument
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced session for factual or technical claims.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use thought-mining stage 3. Check my proposed argument against official or authoritative sources and list any corrections I should make.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Final Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Use thought-mining stages 4 and 5. Review this draft for logic, factual consistency, memorable lines, and publication readiness: [draft].

output_examples.input: I want to write about why team knowledge bases fail.
output_examples.output: The skill would ask open questions, capture insight points, and flag tensions such as outdated ownership, weak incentives, and search friction.

output_examples.input: I have 18 insights about Claude Skills and need a topic.
output_examples.output: It would highlight the strongest themes, ask for a one-sentence claim, and help choose a direction with reader value.

output_examples.input: This draft is almost ready to publish.
output_examples.output: It would review theme clarity, logic, factual consistency, memorable lines, ending strength, and specific revision needs.

best_practices: Start with a clear topic and desired output format.
Pause before web validation when notes include confidential or unpublished information.
Keep generated insight and writing record files in a trusted project folder.
anti_patterns: Publishing factual claims without checking the referenced sources.
Letting the agent write files from unsafe topic names or broad paths.
Skipping early idea capture and asking for a complete article immediately.

faq.question: Can this skill write a full article for me?
faq.answer: It is strongest as a guided thinking and review workflow. It can support drafting, but it is not an automatic publishing system.

faq.question: Does it require web access?
faq.answer: Only the validation stage needs web search. Personal reflections and early idea capture can work without network tools.

faq.question: Will it create files?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow asks the agent to create insight and writing record files in the working directory.

faq.question: Is it suitable for Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What language is it optimized for?
faq.answer: The source instructions are mainly Chinese. It can still guide English sessions if the assistant translates the workflow.

faq.question: How should I handle private ideas?
faq.answer: Avoid web validation for confidential topics unless you approve the search terms. Keep generated files in a trusted workspace.
